subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw retroactively publish signed macOS desktop assets and a beta Sparkle feed for v2026.5.22-beta.1, or should this remain a future beta-release policy change owned by the paired PR?
rationale: The remaining action requires maintainer-held release credentials and a policy decision because current release guidance allows beta native desktop publishing to be optional unless requested.

options.title: Keep paired with the signed-beta PR
options.body: Keep this issue open until release owners decide and land or reject the supported beta desktop/appcast path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845.

options.title: Do not backfill the old beta
options.body: Close after a maintainer explicitly documents that v2026.5.22-beta.1 will remain without macOS desktop assets and future beta trains are handled separately.

options.title: Run private beta mac publish
options.body: Use the private release-ops mac validation and publish workflow to attach signed assets and publish the beta feed for the old tag.

recommendation.title: Keep paired with the signed-beta PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until release owners decide and land or reject the supported beta desktop/appcast path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a release policy and credentialed publish decision rather than a narrow public-repo code fix.
